hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-harz-edge-.slogan: A 220 km loop out of Hannover south-east escape
hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-harz-edge-.story: A real mountain-flavoured day when flatland is not enough. Out of Laatzen and back again: 220 km, roughly 4 h 35 in the saddle. The stops in between: Hildesheim, Goslar old town edge and Torfhaus high road. Okertal bends is the high point.

scenicChapters.title: San Francisco del Valle de Tilaco → Franciscan Missions in the Sierra
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 39 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-san-francisco-del-valle-de-tilaco.story: 297 km from Agua Zarca to Agua Zarca, about 5 h 07 of riding. On the way it passes Franciscan Missions in the Sierra Gorda of, Nuestra Señora de la Luz de Tancoyol, Santiago de Jalpan and San Miguel Concá. The highest point is about 1,600 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Wild Atlantic Way
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 25 km this is Wild Atlantic Way, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
